# Dove Press

> > Dove Press is an open-access publisher of peer-reviewed medical and scientific journals across diverse disciplines including anesthesia, sleep science, oncology, nursing, and specialized biomedical research.

Dove Press maintains both active and archived journals indexed in databases like ESCI and CLOCKSS, adhering to COPE (Committee on Publication Ethics) standards. The publisher offers fee waivers and transparent article publishing charges (APCs) for researchers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed medical journals
- ESCI and CLOCKSS indexing
- Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE)
- Local and Regional Anesthesia
- Nature and Science of Sleep
- Nursing: Research and Reviews
- Journal of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
- Sleep disorders research
- Regional anesthesia
- Evidence-based medicine
- Article publishing charges (APC)
- Journal archives
- Medical research publishing
- SJR and CiteScore metrics

## Active Medical Journals

- [Nursing: Research and Reviews](https://www.dovepress.com//nursing-research-and-reviews-journal): Nursing: Research and Reviews journal - peer-reviewed nursing research
- [Journal of Hepatocellular Carcinoma](https://www.dovepress.com//journal-of-hepatocellular-carcinoma-journal): Journal of Hepatocellular Carcinoma - liver cancer research by Dr Kaseb
- [Nature and Science of Sleep](https://www.dovepress.com//nature-and-science-of-sleep-journal): Nature and Science of Sleep journal - sleep science by Ahmed BaHammam
- [Clinical, Cosmetic and Investigational Dentistry](https://www.dovepress.com//clinical-cosmetic-and-investigational-dentistry-journal): Clinical, Cosmetic and Investigational Dentistry journal by Dr Okunseri

## Journal Archives

- [Local and Regional Anesthesia Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/local-and-regional-anesthesia-archive31): Archive of Local and Regional Anesthesia journal articles on anesthetics
- [Nature and Science of Sleep Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/nature-and-science-of-sleep-archive73): Nature and Science of Sleep archive - sleep disorders and Parkinson's
- [Journal of Blood Medicine Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/journal-of-blood-medicine-archive85): Journal of Blood Medicine archive - hematology and anemia research
- [Journal of Neurorestoratology Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/journal-of-neurorestoratology-archive151): Journal of Neurorestoratology archive - spinal cord and neural repair
- [Core Evidence Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/core-evidence-archive88): Core Evidence archive - evidence-based medicine and drug reviews
- [Comparative Effectiveness Research Archive](https://www.dovepress.com/comparative-effectiveness-research-archive97): Comparative Effectiveness Research archive - CER and PRECIS-2 studies

## Archived Specialized Journals

- [Metalloproteinases In Medicine](https://www.dovepress.com//metalloproteinases-in-medicine-journal): Metalloproteinases In Medicine journal (archived) - ADAMDEC1 research
- [Nanobiosensors in Disease Diagnosis](https://www.dovepress.com//nanobiosensors-in-disease-diagnosis-journal): Nanobiosensors journal (archived) - biosensing and disease diagnosis
- [Journal of Vascular Diagnostics and Interventions](https://www.dovepress.com//journal-of-vascular-diagnostics-journal): Journal of Vascular Diagnostics (archived) - vascular interventions
- [Neuroscience and Neuroeconomics](https://www.dovepress.com//neuroscience-and-neuroeconomics-journal): Neuroscience and Neuroeconomics journal (archived) - brain and behavior
- [Journal of Receptor, Ligand and Channel Research](https://www.dovepress.com//journal-of-receptor-ligand-and-channel-research-journal): Journal of Receptor, Ligand and Channel Research (archived, ESCI-indexed)
